## Summary

From about core 11350 the 68080 has three pipes (Anton, Bruno, Cesar). The cache learns pairing on the second pass of the code.

## Details

- From approx core 11350 onward there are 3 pipes.
- Anton: All instructions fpu & cpu of any length. Can fuse.
- AMMX, FPU, Branches, EA instructions, ALU instructions, BITFIELDS, and complex Multicycle (DIV/movem)
- Bruno: Up to 8byte EA instructions, ALU instructions, Branches. Can fuse.
- Cesar: Up to 8byte EA instructions , Branches. Can fuse.
- Under construction to do ALU instructions. (june 2026)
- Restrictions for all instructions (scalar & fuse) to be executed together:
- Fit in 32byte instruction-cache feed.
- 8byte data-cache feed: 1 read or 1 write or 1 update.
- Bruno & Cesar do not accept multicycle instruction. ( mul, div, (f)movem)
- EA instructions
- ADDA, SUBA, LEA, MOVEA
- Branch instructions
- BRA, BSR, JMP, JSR, RTS
- ALU instructions
- ADD, SUB, MUL, AND, (E)OR, SHIFT
- FPU instructions
- FMOVE, FADD, FMUL, FSUB ...
- 3 EA units to supply
- 3 ALU units, 1 AMMX unit, 5 FPU units (Fmul, Fdiv, Fadd/sub, Fsqrt)
- & 1 branch unit.
- 080 has a 64bit(8byte/quadword) memory interface.
- The first execution of any code runs on a single pipe, the cache learns the pairing from the second pass on.
- Two instruction fuses , and Bank runs on 1st execution already.
- On 2nd code execution BRUNO decoder is active and also his fusing works.
- On 3rd iteration CESAR can also join the party.
- Branch caches are learning where branches are and which way they go more often

### Bruno (second pipe) examples

| Bruno accepts | Instructions |
|---|---|
| No | to from ccr/cr/usp, subx addx negx, mul div, abcd nbcd sbcd, xshift shift ,(ea), bitfield, exg, cmp2 cmpm chk(2) cas(2), moves movep movem movec, (un)link un(pack), perm bank, nop, rte rts jsr bsr bcc |
| Yes | bra bcc dbra jmp, (e)or(i) and(i) clr neg not tst, cmpi cmp(a), subi subq sub(a) addi addq add(a), btst/bchg/bclr/bset, move(a) moveq, lea pea swap ext, shift ,Dn, touch, store |

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68060 has two pipes. The 68080 has three, with different rules per pipe, and only pairs code after the first pass.

## Do / Don't

- DON'T expect multicycle instructions (mul, div, (f)movem) in Bruno or Cesar.
- DO keep instruction groups within the 32-byte instruction-cache feed and one data-cache access (8 bytes) per cycle.
